records.speaker: Camille
records.context: Samwell asks Camille who the man in a portrait is and whether he is famous. Camille identifies Rocco Alemkel and gives a qualified assessment of his reputation among navigators. Impatient Lil interrupts and announces she is going ahead. Camille apologizes; Samwell promises to follow and provokes Lil with an explicit body-size taunt. Her retaliation starts a comic chase with four impact sounds. Camille calls the runtime FI name, complains about thrown objects and reacts with Ow. Samwell taunts the thrower and Lil pursues him. Camille grumbles about always having to clean up, notices something and judges a book to look very old. Lil calls him onward. His question about Samwell receives her irritated dismissal; his private thought infers another escape. She challenges his grin and he stammers an apology, redirecting her to the found object. She asks if it is a gift and continues with that interpretation despite two unfinished corrections. Her delight at the unusual present turns into thanks and a renewed invitation to go. Camille yields awkwardly and privately wonders whether that was okay. No deliberate gift purchase, settled ownership or romance is established.

records.source_Japanese: あ…、うん
records.speaker: Camille
records.context: Samwell asks Camille who the man in a portrait is and whether he is famous. Camille identifies Rocco Alemkel and gives a qualified assessment of his reputation among navigators. Impatient Lil interrupts and announces she is going ahead. Camille apologizes; Samwell promises to follow and provokes Lil with an explicit body-size taunt. Her retaliation starts a comic chase with four impact sounds. Camille calls the runtime FI name, complains about thrown objects and reacts with Ow. Samwell taunts the thrower and Lil pursues him. Camille grumbles about always having to clean up, notices something and judges a book to look very old. Lil calls him onward. His question about Samwell receives her irritated dismissal; his private thought infers another escape. She challenges his grin and he stammers an apology, redirecting her to the found object. She asks if it is a gift and continues with that interpretation despite two unfinished corrections. Her delight at the unusual present turns into thanks and a renewed invitation to go. Camille yields awkwardly and privately wonders whether that was okay. No deliberate gift purchase, settled ownership or romance is established.
records.localization_note: Keep the hesitant acknowledgment after Lil thanks him. Uh... yeah. suits Camille's awkward spoken response; Ah... yes. is stiffer than this exchange. He yields without explaining, and the misunderstanding remains unresolved.
